groups.id: roof material surfaces and paired prism
groups.comparison: tessellate_roof_face normalizes the coupled plane normal only for orientation/thickness displacement, not mutating plane equation or pretending normalized constant. It feeds the same flattened outer+remaining cutout vertices and hole starts to earcut, retrieves indexed triples, orients each to same normal, emits paired reversed interior offset and boundary edges. Weather/interior/boundary/enclosure classifications deliberately affect detailed rendering while coarse shell may ignore distinction. Plane/polygon coplanarity and shape admission remain original roof-source obligations; this renderer does not validate every raw RoofFace.

Boundary cutout first attempts same-edge two touchpoints, sorts their local parameters, walks cutout cycle between distinct positions with direction selected to keep interior path; touches.len==2 proves nonempty cutout before modulus. Corner fallback requires an actual shared outer vertex plus previous/next touches and one interior point, otherwise retains cutout as hole. Outer loops guard empty modulo; same_point uses .002 distance tolerance. remove_collinear loop removes one only while len>3, terminates, guarded expect removable actual Some. These operations assume supported coherent polygon/cutout topology, not a general arbitrary self-intersection repair. Native earcut implementation not present in global scope and not source-read; index-range/native triangulation contract stays explicit rather than blanket foreign proof.

groups.id: same triangulation closes only unshared edges
groups.comparison: append_boundary_sides compares each oriented top edge with all other edges in either direction under same_point. Only unique boundary edges create two offset side triangles; shared triangulation diagonals omitted. Derived cross product produces same side normal for both triangles. Raw duplicate/nonmanifold polygons may defeat physical closure, not accepted by this helper; source does not seal public mutable triangle records. Actual UV helpers compute along-surface distances and downhill tangent, horizontal fallback explicit; positive nonzero metres_per_unit/native normalized triangle inputs required, no generic finite arithmetic promise. Original pitch/azimuth and hole-area/winding/closed-mesh fixtures fully read, not run.

Enclosure len>=3 before first vertex, derives same normal/tangent/plane, asks actual residual against current walls, concatenates each polygon ring with hole starts, drops ring closing duplicate and rebuilds positions from same plane/tangent/elevation. Actual residual contract supplies closed nonempty rings; no .len()-1 safety inferred for unrelated raw native Polygon. Same paired offset and boundary helper applies. No unregistered residual helper body or native geometry package proof.

groups.id: physical overlap operation has no retained duplicate authority
groups.comparison: solid_overlap transforms actual triangle into same solid local yaw/crossfall/longfall frame; SAT uses three coordinate axes, triangle normal and edge cross axes, omits nearzero axes and tests positive tolerance penetration. Cuboid versus AABB similarly combines actual world/local/cross axes and radii. Does not retain stale projection or independent geometry owner. Bounds ordered/finite native arithmetic and tolerance meaning are caller preconditions; these methods are crate-private, no current normal extreme API witness established here. Actual corner-contact and empty-AABB-overlap fixture read only. No broad shape-envelope containment clearance from bounding cuboid SAT.

spatial_geometry.rs reexports canonical frame/coordinate/displacement/dimensions/orientation owners and declares modules/tests. It states signed coordinates/zero displacement allowed and direction/rotation normalization; reexports contain no duplicated state or collection relationship. Actual lower definitions have separate prior05 cells; this wiring receives no blanket constructor/mutation coverage.
